PANCAKE TOWER - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-pancaketower.txt.

A chubby chef is stacking the tallest pile of pancakes the world has ever
seen. A pancake slides left and right above the tower: press A to drop it.
Whatever hangs over the edge is cut off and flops down the side, and the next
pancake is that much narrower. Drop it spot on for a perfect (and a butter
pat): chain eight and the pancakes grow back. Toppings land every tenth
pancake, syrup makes the next one slide a little, and the tower climbs through
the kitchen ceiling, out of the roof, past the birds and the clouds, all the
way to space. Golden fork medals at 25, 50, 75 and 100; your best is kept.

Run PancakeTower.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls (SNES gamepad layout)
  A: start from the title.
  A: drop a pancake. The first A starts play; the next A drops.
  After game over, A returns to the title; press A again to start.
  Start or Select during play: pause/resume.
  Pads 2-4: A or Start to join on the title, B to leave.

Keyboard: X = A, Z = B, arrows = D-pad, Enter = Start,
Backspace or Esc = Select. Other players use gamepads.

Up to four chefs stack in separate columns. Every third perfect splashes the next living rival. When everyone has missed, height wins, then score.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: PancakeTower.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The best score is saved in pancaketower.srm next to the exe.
